Keep a plain unseasoned piece aside for the dog.Central Park charred corn chicken bowlsSmoky grilled thighs over rice with black beans, chilli lime butter, parmesan, avocado and corianderHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSmoky grilled chicken thighs over rice with charred corn, black beans, chilli lime butter, parmesan, avocado and coriander.Toss 800g chicken thighs with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, salt and oil.Grill 4 cobs of corn over hot coals for 10 minutes until charred, then grill the chicken 5 minutes a side.Cook 300g rice.Mix 40g soft butter with chilli flakes and lime zest.Cut the corn from the cobs and toss with the butter.Build bowls with rice, sliced chicken, corn, a drained 400g tin black beans, avocado, grated parmesan and coriander.Sweet issueNeville's Shrek night rice puddingSlow baked creamy rice pudding with nutmeg and raspberry jamHow to make it100g short grain rice60g caster sugar1 L full cream milk1 lemon1 whole nutmeg30g butter4 tbsp raspberry jamHeat the oven to 150°C and butter a baking dish.Stir the rice, sugar and milk together in the dish and add a long strip of lemon peel.Grate nutmeg over the top and dot with butter.Bake, stirring once after 30 minutes, until thick and creamy with a golden skin.Rest, then serve warm with a spoon of raspberry jam.CanteenLight up the darkness bourbon peach smashBourbon shaken with canned peach, lemon and mint, over crushed iceHow to make it410g tinned sliced peaches, drained (keep 60ml syrup)1 lemon10 mint leaves4 mint sprigs, to garnish200ml bourbon1 bag crushed ice2 cups ice, for shakingMuddle half the peach slices with the syrup, lemon juice and mint leaves in a shaker.Add the bourbon and ice and shake hard.Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice and garnish with a peach slice and a mint sprig.Moka pot espressoBrewed with Bob Marley on the stereo.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
